features.feature: 5-phase canonical round (frozen order: lenses->verify-lens-findings->critic->verify-critic-findings->converge-or-reopen) implemented by runAdversarialRound
AdversarialRoundResult extends RoundResult with confirmedByLane (per-lane per-lens attribution)
Critic receives VERIFIED (confirmed post-§2.3) lens findings — never raw lens output (§2.4 invariant)
Task-tunable RoundConfig (lensSet, skeptics, threshold) with defaults from CANONICAL_LENS_SET
Injectable RoundSeams (runLens, runSkeptic, runCritic) enabling hermetic testing
converged + reopen flags on AdversarialRoundResult (convergence criterion per §3.1: no confirmed lens AND no confirmed critic)
deriveRoundLedgerOps: finding_add LedgerOps for each confirmed lens finding (via S2 toFindingAddArgs, per-lane attribution)
deriveRoundLedgerOps: finding_add LedgerOps for each confirmed critic finding (via S3 toCriticFindingAddArgs, [completeness-critic] prefix in desc, agent=real lattice-review-* lane)
deriveRoundLedgerOps: review_pass_set LedgerOps per lane only when round.converged (no pass on reopen)
No abstract severity (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR) in any ledger op — only critical|high|medium|low reach finding_add
deriveRoundLedgerOps is PURE — derives op descriptors only, performs no actual finding_add or review_pass_set CLI call
runReopenLoop: loop-until-dry with maxRounds bound; applyFix seam produces new change on each reopen; returns {rounds, converged, finalChange}
buildHostVerdictPayloads: 3x2 shaper producing HostVerdictPayload[] with distinct hostId/sessionId/keyId per host, same materialDigest+validationDigest; decision defaults to pass
buildHostVerdictPayloads is PURE — no CLI call, no Authority receipt (local-only §4.5)
Hermetic smoke asserting REVIEW_MODE_PHASES equals canonical 5-phase frozen array with explicit string literals
Smoke: capturing fake runCritic proves critic seam received CONFIRMED (verified) lens set not raw (§2.4 invariant)
Smoke: clean round (all skeptics refute) proves converged=true, reopen=false, criticFindings=[]
Smoke: B-086b reopen trace via runReopenLoop (critic finding on round 1, applyFix, clean round 2, rounds.length===2, result.converged===true)
Smoke: maxRounds bound proves converged=false when never-clean
Smoke: deriveRoundLedgerOps end-to-end (agent=real lane, severity=ledger kind not abstract, critic desc prefix, review_pass_set only on converge)
Smoke: buildHostVerdictPayloads yields 2 payloads with distinct hostId/keyId/sessionId, same materialDigest+validationDigest, decision pass
Smoke registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands as node packages/main/dist/tasks/adversarial-review-round-smoke.js
